description: Stijn Roels of KU Leuven provides field measurements from the Vliet test building to assess hygrothermal performance of hydrophobised masonry walls. The study compares vapour-tight and capillary-active internal-insulation systems, alongside walls without hydrophobisation and walls without insulation. Construction and sensor-installation photographs accompany the measurements. Zenodo lists 95 CSV, XLSX and image files, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The resource describes the behaviour of a specific building-envelope treatment under field exposure and can support comparison of heat-and-moisture models. A limitation is that the inspected description does not state the full monitoring interval, sample step or complete sensor schema. Filenames include dated measurement labels, but these do not prove continuous coverage. The related RIBuild historic-building survey describes broader stock and renovation cases. This field study is distinct from the separately described KU Leuven hotbox/coldbox experiment; no files were opened.
